Sure! Here’s a simple yet flavorful way to prepare an **Indian‑style grilled steak** at home:

---

### Ingredients  

| Item | Quantity |
|------|----------|
| Ribeye / Sirloin steak (1–2 lb) | 1 piece per person |
| Yogurt (plain) | ½ cup |
| Lemon juice | 1 tbsp |
| Garlic cloves | 3–4, minced |
| Fresh ginger | 1 inch, grated |
| Ground cumin | 1 tsp |
| Ground coriander | 1 tsp |
| Garam masala | ½ tsp |
| Turmeric powder | ¼ tsp |
| Red chili flakes (optional) | ½ tsp |
| Salt & pepper | to taste |
| Olive oil or melted ghee | 2 tbsp |
| Fresh cilantro leaves | handful, chopped |

> *Tip:* Marinate overnight if you have time – it makes the meat extra tender!

---

### Marinade Preparation  
1. In a bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, garam masala, turmeric, red chili flakes, salt, pepper, and olive oil/ghee until smooth.  
2. Place the steak(s) in a shallow dish or zip‑lock bag; pour the mixture over them so they’re fully coated.  
3. Seal/cover and refrigerate for **at least 4 hours**, ideally overnight. Turn occasionally to ensure even marination.

---

### Grilling Steps  

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1️⃣ Preheat grill | Heat your gas or charcoal grill to high heat (~450°F). If using a stovetop pan, preheat it hot with a little oil. |
| 2️⃣ Remove excess marinades | Take steaks out of fridge; let them sit at room temp ~15 min before grilling. Pat dry lightly—this helps sear better. |
| 3️⃣ Grill | Sear each side for about 3–5 minutes depending on thickness and preferred doneness. Use tongs only; avoid pressing the steak. |
| 4️⃣ Check internal temp | Aim for 125°F (rare), 135°F (medium‑rare), 145°F (medium), etc., using instant-read thermometer. Remember temperatures rise slightly after resting. |
| 5️⃣ Rest | Let the steak rest 5–7 mins covered loosely with foil. It allows juices to redistribute. |
| 6️⃣ Serve | Slice against grain into thin strips. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve alongside naan, rice, or sautéed veggies. |

---

#### Optional “Masala Butter” Finish  
While the steak rests, melt 2 tbsp butter in a small saucepan. Add a pinch of garam masala and a squeeze of lime juice. Drizzle this warm sauce over sliced steak right before serving for an indulgent finish.

---

### Quick Side Ideas  

| Dish | Why it works |
|------|--------------|
| **Cucumber raita** | Cool cucumber + yogurt balances spice. |
| **Garlic naan** | Soft bread perfect for scooping sauces. |
| **Sauteed spinach** | Light greens add color and nutrition. |
| **Roasted bell peppers** | Sweetness contrasts smoky steak. |

Enjoy your deliciously spiced Indian‑styled steak! 🍽️🥩
